title: What is Apollo
description: Understand Apollo Client and its role in React applications.

data.text: **Apollo Client** is a comprehensive state management library for JavaScript that enables you to manage both local and remote data with GraphQL. It's the most popular GraphQL client for React.

items: **Declarative data fetching**: Describe what data you need, Apollo fetches it
**Optimistic UI**: Update UI before server confirms
**Type safety**: Generate types from GraphQL schema

data.title: GraphQL
data.text: GraphQL is a query language for APIs. It allows clients to request exactly the data they need, making it perfect for complex applications.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Apollo Client is a GraphQL client for React
data.takeaway: Apollo simplifies GraphQL data management in React.
